objective: Make every sidebar level and article route expose an intelligible local connection without inventing one universal reading chain.

navigation_contract.category_stage: map, target, just-in-time foundation, or implementation
navigation_contract.source_article: optional evidence attached to a core concept
navigation_contract.article: linked parent, current position, previous step, and next step

events.observed: AI 전체 지도, 지식 시스템 and 로봇 AI were presented as three equivalent map entries.
events.inference: The first is orientation while the other two are destination capabilities.
events.decision: Keep AI 전체 지도 alone in stage 00 and move 지식 시스템 and 로봇 AI to stage 01.
events.verification: Sidebar tests assert exact stage membership on mobile and desktop.

events.observed: Parent routes flattened unrelated descendant articles into one implied sequence.
events.inference: A parent with children must help readers choose a branch, not prescribe all branches.
events.decision: Render child branches before any parent-owned material and suppress flattened descendant cards.
events.verification: LLM renders five branches and zero descendant article cards; AML/CFT retains its direct article.

events.observed: Large leaves exposed many articles without a visible starting point or position.
events.inference: A leaf is the narrowest trustworthy scope for deterministic local ordering.
events.decision: Number core articles, summarize start/end, and fold source records into an optional evidence section.
events.verification: Reth renders all 22 core entries with stable positions.

events.observed: 433 articles had no hand-authored learning-path context.
events.inference: Direct visits still need a truthful local route, but a global semantic chain cannot be inferred safely.
events.decision: Generate same-subcategory fallback navigation and prefer a valid declared route when present.
events.verification: All 541 articles resolve; unknown, missing and broken path counts are zero.

events.observed: A long next-article title exceeded its mobile card by 25 pixels.
events.inference: An inline min-width rule did not create a shrinkable flex item, and truncation hid useful context.
events.decision: Use a block flex item with min-width zero and wrapped title text.
events.verification: The targeted formula/Viz mobile overflow test and the full suite pass.

fallback_algorithm: find the exact containing subcategory recursively
separate source and paper records from core records
preserve authored order within each group
navigate only inside the article's matching group
use a valid declared learning path when it explicitly contains the article

source_policy.frontier_update: append the new item to the top of its target route
source_policy.foundation_update: add a lower prerequisite only when the new frontier item introduces a strict dependency
source_policy.history_rule: publication age alone never makes a source mandatory

small_model_replay.four_b_scope: classify one parent or leaf and return node_kind, reader_outcome, strict_prerequisites, core_articles, optional_sources, and placement_reason
small_model_replay.nine_b_scope: review one category for branch exclusivity, orphan articles, cycles, source links, and start-to-finish capability progression
